sections.name: goal
sections.value: Every role names one of pij's ten seat types, and pij shows and uses it.

value.title: Blueprint for seat types, starting a role and pods
value.done_when: One blueprint realises every requirement of PRDs 006, 007, 008 and 010, and each later step in those workstreams names the component it builds.
value.note: The blueprint is shared by workstreams 006, 007, 008 and 010. Ruled 2026-11-25: a seat has one label, its type; prime, project manager and PA carry today's authority and the other types carry none.

value.title: Type on the role, the ten definitions and their seed templates
value.done_when: `pij directory add` refuses a role with no type, asks for what the type requires, and pij prints each type's definition and seed template.

value.title: pij shows and uses the type
value.done_when: `pij list` and `pij directory` show each seat's type, a seat holding two types is flagged, and every existing permission test passes.

value.title: Give existing roles a type
value.done_when: One command types every role in a community written before the change and lists those it could not decide.

value.change: Owner moved from pij-autonomous-parrot to pm-001, which runs the build of PRDs 006, 007, 008 and 010.
s01 complete: blueprint 005. s02 to s04 name the components they build and their plans (236, 237, 238).
